title: Wipe a low table

steps.tip: It should be wet, not dripping.

steps.text: Move crumbs and toys off the table first.
steps.tip: Put crumbs in the trash, not on the floor.
Start at one side and walk the cloth to the other.

done_when: Cloth is back where it belongs
parent_notes: Use water or kid-safe cleaner only. No spray bottles for little helpers.
